svg.title: Neoantimon2: variants to traceable peptide–HLA candidates
svg.desc: User-declared samples, patients and HLA plus explicit references support variant events, multiple sequence and translation paths, shared peptide sequences and peptide–HLA candidates. Separately acquired references and predictors are not bundled. Optional configured local prediction and supplied observations support native prioritization and explanations. Longitudinal sample graphs can belong to the current project or explicitly bound completed runs, with explicit settings. A completed project can export queries and all origins without native prediction scores or grades for a separately run external model, optional conversion, strict matching and an independent derived analysis. Native results are preserved. Longitudinal, vaccine-set and restricted indirect-HLA/allo views have separate opt-in requirements. Missing evidence is neither zero nor an evaluated negative. Research outputs do not establish clinical validation.

text.tspan: Native analysis and a separate External route; references and predictors are obtained separately
Multiple paths can share a peptide; every candidate–origin link is retained.
B EXTERNAL — a separate derived view
Completed Neoantimon2 project — scores / grades not required
Import requires the original completed project. Strict matching preserves all origin links.
External grades require MHC percentiles + eligible core somatic evidence; raw scores alone do not grade.
Specialized workflows — explicit opt-ins; external scores do not feed these views
Missing evidence ≠ zero ≠ evaluated negative • Research outputs, not clinical validation
